# Outer-scale boundary strip: shape and boundary derivatives

Companion to [the full proof](SHORT_SCALE_OUTER_LARGE_RATIO.md). For each of the five fixed beta slopes, \(N_{ji}=-\Delta_{ji}F_i\) is defined there. The following identities differentiate before expanding:

\[
(N_{ji})_a=g_{ji}P_{ji}(A,H),\qquad (N_{ji})_a+\frac52(N_{ji})_x=h_{ji}R_{ji}(A,H),
\]

where \(A=a-1\), \(H=x-2a+1\). Both derivatives are of the already substituted two-variable function at the fixed beta slope. Each polynomial has 44 monomials and total degree eight.
